summary.text: Allen Chesser is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 25 in Nash County who has served since January 1, 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia, which lists him as Allen Chesser II, describes his career as law enforcement, and the General Assembly lists his occupation as civil engineering technician.

paragraphs.text: Chesser graduated from Bunn High School in 2003 and served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2003 to 2009, according to Ballotpedia.
The General Assembly lists his military experience as Army and Army National Guard, 2003 to 2009.
Chesser succeeded Democrat James Gailliard in House District 25.

He chairs the Appropriations Subcommittee on Transportation, the Regulatory Reform Committee and the House Select Committee on Blockchain and Digital Assets, and is vice chairman of the Appropriations Committee and of the Homeland Security and Military and Veterans Affairs Committee.
